description: This Scala source file defines a helper object 'ResourceRequestHelper' for managing resource requests in Spark on YARN. It includes methods for parsing resource configurations, validating resource definitions, and setting resource information in YARN Resource objects.

methods.name: getYarnResourcesAndAmounts
methods.description: Parses Spark configuration to extract resource names and their amounts, ensuring only the supported suffix '$AMOUNT' is used.

methods.name: getResourceNameMapping
methods.description: Returns a mapping of resource types (GPU, FPGA) to their corresponding YARN device configuration values.

methods.name: getYarnResourcesFromSparkResources
methods.description: Converts Spark resource configurations into YARN resource mappings for GPU and FPGA resources.

methods.name: validateResources
methods.description: Validates Spark configuration to prevent conflicting resource definitions for memory and cores between Spark and YARN.

methods.name: setResourceRequests
methods.description: Sets resource amounts and units in a YARN Resource object based on Spark resource configuration.

methods.name: createResourceInformation
methods.description: Creates a ResourceInformation instance with specified resource name, amount, and unit.
